data.title: The Weathervane
data.rumour: Town Hall's whale is off the roof for repairs.
about: Dale Corrigan, the roofer repairing Town Hall's copper whale weathervane, tries to sell it to you as "scrap" because his boat payment is due (§{daleVane}). Refuse, or call the police on the spot (Turned In). If you buy it, he texts in a panic before the selectmen sit and asks you onto the roof (§{vaneRoof}).

Help him bolt it back on, faster with a tool or climbing gear in your bag (Back on the Roof), sell it to a no-questions collector in Newport for $400 and draw the police's attention (Gone Whaling), or call Captain Barrow, who went to high school with Dale (Turned In). Town Meeting's Article 7 (§{vaneArticle}) then hears that the whale fixed itself, was stolen, or is in the evidence room.

weathervane.name: Copper whale weathervane
tells: Stamped under the tail: HOLLOW NECK 1888.
The green on it is a century deep. Nobody made this for scrap.

daleVane.title: Dale Corrigan has some copper "scrap" in the truck

text: Dale Corrigan, Corrigan Roofing. You heard Town Hall's whale is off the roof for repairs? I'm the repairs.
Anyway. Unrelated. I've got some copper scrap in the truck. Big old whale shape. Sixty bucks and it's yours.
Great. Great. It's scrap. Just so we're clear. It came off in my hands, and copper's at a good price, and the boat payment was due, and...

else.text: Yeah. No. You're right. I'll... think of something.

vaneRoof.title: On the Town Hall roof with Dale and the whale
vaneRoof.note: The lunch errand: Dale, guilty, wants it back on the roof before the selectmen sit at one.

steps.narrate: A text at eleven: "pls. the whale. selectmen sit at 1. i will owe u forever. - D". So at noon you're on the roof of Town Hall with a copper whale under one arm and a roofer who won't look at you.

steps.text: It really did come off in my hands. Then I had it in the truck. Then I had a bad idea. Then I had you.

choose.label: Help him bolt it back on

narrate.then: The {kit.name|lower} makes a job of it instead of an adventure. Five minutes, and the whale swings back to face the harbor before the first selectman is out of his car.
narrate.else: Your kit makes a job of it instead of an adventure. Five minutes, and the whale swings back to face the harbor before the first selectman is out of his car.

then.text: That was professional. That was more professional than me. Here. All sixty. I don't deserve to keep any of it.

else.narrate: Twenty minutes, two wrenches and one near-death experience later, the whale swings back to face the harbor. Somewhere below, the selectmen arrive and don't look up.

else.text: I'll pay you back the sixty. Out of the Town Hall job. Which I still have. Because of you.

else.why: Dale paid back half the whale

choose.label: Ring a collector in Newport instead

then.why: Sold Town Hall's whale to a collector

then.narrate: The collector's van is in the Town Hall lot by two. He doesn't ask a single question, which is how you know exactly what kind of collector he is.

then.text: Oh no. Oh, no no no. They're going to notice. They're going to look UP.

then.narrate: Captain Barrow climbs the ladder herself, looks at Dale, looks at the whale, and sighs the sigh of a woman who went to high school with him.

vaneArticle.title: Town Meeting, Article 7: the weathervane
vaneArticle.note: At Town Meeting, the whale is on the warrant either way.

narrate: Article 7: to see if the Town will raise $3,000 to repair the Town Hall weathervane. The Building Committee reports, with some confusion, that it appears to have repaired itself.
The article is passed over. Dale Corrigan, in the back row, gives you a very small thumbs up.

else.narrate: Article 7: to see if the Town will raise $3,000 to replace the Town Hall weathervane, "removed by persons unknown". It passes. Dale Corrigan, in the back row, does not raise his hand or his eyes.
Article 7: to see if the Town will raise $3,000 to repair the Town Hall weathervane. Captain Barrow reports that the whale is in the evidence room and "in good spirits". Laughter. It passes.

errands.title: Dale needs the whale back on Town Hall

mornings.note: the whale is missed the morning after it goes

then.toast: The Gazette: "Who took Town Hall's whale?" There's a photo of the empty cupola.

mornings.note: you skipped the errand: it's still in your stock, and now it's hot

then.toast: Town Hall's whale has been reported missing. The one in your back room.

weathervane.note: sold over the counter instead: gone whaling
